verification_method.design: Paired baseline/treatment on the same model, reasoning setting, immutable checkout, dependency matrix and frozen issue body; baseline receives no AEG experience, treatment additionally receives the immutable staged lifecycle experience. Issue comments and later public analyses are withheld from both solving contexts and reserved for the evaluator oracle.

technical_oracle: Reproduce first initialization success and second initialization failure with sse-starlette 3.4.11 under sequential Uvicorn restarts.
Show the same second initialization succeeds with sse-starlette 3.0.2.
Show a diagnostic-only AppStatus.should_exit reset restores the second initialization under 3.4.11.

verification_method.efficacy_threshold: Treatment must be at least as technically correct as baseline and improve at least one recorded efficiency measure by >=20% fewer completed diagnostic steps, >=15% fewer non-cached tokens, or >=20% lower wall time. If metrics are unavailable, the result is INCONCLUSIVE; if treatment misapplies the experience or is less correct, the transfer hypothesis fails.
verification_method.safety: Use an isolated temporary checkout without publishing credentials. No upstream comment, pull request, production fix, main-branch change, global Agent/plugin installation or paid API.

existing_results.issue_author_reported: Repeated server starts produce incomplete SSE initialization responses on MCP 2.2.0 and 1.30.0; a reused single server does not show the same pattern.
existing_results.public_independent_reported: At the frozen SDK revision, sse-starlette 3.4.11 fails on the second initialization, while 3.0.2 and a diagnostic AppStatus reset succeed.
existing_results.falsified_alternative: A final-send ordering patch fixes a controlled plain-SSE interleaving but does not fix the actual restart path.
existing_results.limitations: No production repair is established; fresh-process CPU-contention failures remain out of scope; public comments disclose the evaluator oracle and must not enter either solving context.
